function v_u_5.bubble() -- name: bubble

function v_u_5.placeBubble(p437, p438, p439, p440, p441, p442, p443) -- name: placeBubble
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4
	local v444 = p443 or 1
	local v445 = p439.RightVector
	local v446 = p439.UpVector
	local v447 = p438 + v445 * (2.1 * v444) + v446 * 2
	local v448 = CFrame.fromMatrix(v447, v445, v446)
	local v449 = math.clamp(p441 or 0, 0, 1)
	local v450 = CFrame.Angles(0, 1.5707963267948966, 0)
	for v451, v452 in ipairs(p437.discs) do
		local v453 = v452.part
		local v454 = v451 <= 3 and v452.x * v444 or v452.x
		local v455 = v_u_4
		local v456 = v452.y
		local v457 = (p440 or 0) * 2 + v451
		v453.CFrame = v448 * v455(v454, v456 + math.sin(v457) * 0.04, 0.02 * v452.layer) * v450
		local v458 = (v449 - (v451 <= 3 and (v451 - 1) * 0.12 or 0.4 + 0.04 * (v451 - 4))) / 0.15
		local v459 = 1 - math.clamp(v458, 0, 1)
		local v460 = v453.Transparency - v459
		if math.abs(v460) <= 0.001 then
			continue
		end
		v453.Transparency = v459
	end
	local v461 = (v449 - 0.75) / 0.15
	local v462 = 1 - math.clamp(v461, 0, 1)
	local v463 = (p440 or 0) * 5
	local v464 = math.sin(v463) * 0.05
	p437.sea.CFrame = v448 * v_u_4(0.2, 0.05, 0.17)
	p437.sun.CFrame = v448 * v_u_4(0.95, 1.25, 0.16)
	for _, v465 in ipairs({ p437.sea, p437.sun }) do
		local v466 = v465.Transparency - v462
		if math.abs(v466) <= 0.001 then
			continue
		end
		v465.Transparency = v462
	end
	local v467 = math.clamp(p442 or 0, 0, 1) * 1.3 + -0.65
	local v468 = p437.boat
	local v469 = v448 * v_u_4(v467, v464 + 0.24, 0.3)
	local v470 = CFrame.Angles
	local v471 = (p440 or 0) * 4
	v468:PivotTo(v469 * v470(0, 0, math.sin(v471) * 0.06))
	for _, v472 in ipairs(p437.boatParts) do
		local v473 = v472.Transparency - v462
		if math.abs(v473) <= 0.001 then
			continue
		end
		v472.Transparency = v462
	end
end

function v_u_5.setBeacons(p234, p235) -- name: setBeacons
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10
	local v236 = p234:FindFirstChild("BeaconR")
	local v237 = p234:FindFirstChild("BeaconB")
	local v238 = p235 * 3.141592653589793 / 1.2
	local v239 = math.sin(v238) * 0.5 + 0.5
	if v236 then
		v236.Color = v_u_10.beaconRDim:Lerp(v_u_10.beaconR, v239)
	end
	if v237 then
		v237.Color = v_u_10.beaconBDim:Lerp(v_u_10.beaconB, 1 - v239)
	end
end

function v_u_5.sheetCFs(p384, p385, p386, p387) -- name: sheetCFs
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_3
	local v388 = p386 or {}
	local v389 = v_u_5.SHEET
	local v390 = v388.bend or 0
	local v391 = v388.curl or 0
	local v392 = v388.flutter or 0
	local v393 = v388.phase or 0
	local v394 = v389.w / 2
	local v395 = v388.edge
	local v396 = v388.wrap or 0
	local v397 = math.clamp(v396, 0, 1)
	local v398 = v388.wrapR or 0.7
	local v399 = v388.foldAt or 0.5
	local v400 = p387 or {}
	for v401, v402 in ipairs(p384.segs) do
		local v403 = v402.u
		local v404 = v402.v
		local v405 = v403 + 0.06
		local v406 = v395 and (math.abs(v405) / v394 or 1) or 1
		local v407 = v390 * v405 * v405 + v391 * v404 * v404
		local v408 = v392 * v406
		local v409 = 3.1 * v405 + 2.3 * v404 + v393
		local v410 = v407 + v408 * math.sin(v409)
		local v411 = v403 - 0.06
		local v412 = v395 and (math.abs(v411) / v394 or 1) or 1
		local v413 = v390 * v411 * v411 + v391 * v404 * v404
		local v414 = v392 * v412
		local v415 = 3.1 * v411 + 2.3 * v404 + v393
		local v416 = v_u_3(0.12, 0, v410 - (v413 + v414 * math.sin(v415)))
		local v417 = v404 + 0.06
		local v418 = v395 and (math.abs(v403) / v394 or 1) or 1
		local v419 = v390 * v403 * v403 + v391 * v417 * v417
		local v420 = v392 * v418
		local v421 = 3.1 * v403 + 2.3 * v417 + v393
		local v422 = v419 + v420 * math.sin(v421)
		local v423 = v404 - 0.06
		local v424 = v395 and (math.abs(v403) / v394 or 1) or 1
		local v425 = v390 * v403 * v403 + v391 * v423 * v423
		local v426 = v392 * v424
		local v427 = 3.1 * v403 + 2.3 * v423 + v393
		local v428 = v_u_3(0, 0.12, v422 - (v425 + v426 * math.sin(v427)))
		local v429 = v416.Unit
		local v430 = v416:Cross(v428).Unit
		local v431 = v430:Cross(v429).Unit
		local v432 = CFrame.fromMatrix
		local v433 = v395 and (math.abs(v403) / v394 or 1) or 1
		local v434 = v390 * v403 * v403 + v391 * v404 * v404
		local v435 = v392 * v433
		local v436 = 3.1 * v403 + 2.3 * v404 + v393
		local v437 = p385 * v432(v_u_3(v403, v404, v434 + v435 * math.sin(v436)) + v430 * (0.004 * v402.odd), v429, v431)
		if v397 > 0 and v388.wrapCF then
			local v438 = v403 / v398
			local v439, v440
			if v399 < v404 then
				local v441 = (v404 - v399) / v398
				v404 = v399 + v398 * math.sin(v441)
				v439 = v398 * (1 - math.cos(v441))
				v440 = v_u_3(0, math.cos(v441), (math.sin(v441)))
			else
				v440 = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
				v439 = 0
			end
			local v442 = v_u_3(math.cos(v438), 0, (math.sin(v438)))
			local v443 = (v440 - v442 * v440:Dot(v442)).Unit
			local v444 = v_u_3(v398 * math.sin(v438), v404, -v398 * math.cos(v438) + v439) + v442:Cross(v443) * (0.004 * v402.odd)
			v437 = v437:Lerp(v388.wrapCF * CFrame.fromMatrix(v444, v442, v443), v397)
		end
		v400[v401] = v437
	end
	return v400
end
function v_u_5.peelCFs(p445, p446, p447, p448, p449, p450, p451) -- name: peelCFs
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_4
	local v452 = v_u_5.SHEET
	local v453 = v452.w * v452.w + v452.h * v452.h
	local v454 = math.sqrt(v453)
	local v455 = p451 or {}
	for v456, v457 in ipairs(p445.segs) do
		local v458 = (v457.u - p449) ^ 2 + (v457.v - p450) ^ 2
		local v459 = math.sqrt(v458) / v454
		local v460 = (p448 * 1.6 - v459) / 0.6
		local v461 = math.clamp(v460, 0, 1)
		local v462 = v461 * v461 * (3 - v461 * 2)
		local v463 = p446[v456]:Lerp(p447[v456], v462)
		local v464 = v_u_4
		local v465 = v462 * 3.141592653589793
		v455[v456] = v463 * v464(0, 0, math.sin(v465) * -0.18)
	end
	return v455
end

function v_u_5.setRainbow(p505, p506) -- name: setRainbow
	local v507 = 1 - math.clamp(p506, 0, 1) * 0.65
	for _, v508 in ipairs(p505:GetChildren()) do
		if not v508:IsA("BasePart") then
			continue
		end

			continue
		end
		v508.Transparency = v507
	end
end

function v_u_14.animateGulls(p882, p883, p884) -- name: animateGulls
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_12
	for _, v885 in ipairs(p882) do
		local v886 = p883 * v885.w + v885.ph
		local v887 = v885.r * math.cos(v886)
		local v888 = v885.h
		local v889 = p883 * 1.7 + v885.ph
		local v890 = p884 + v_u_11(v887, v888 + math.sin(v889) * 0.6, v885.r * 0.6 * math.sin(v886))
		local v891 = v_u_11(-math.sin(v886), 0, math.cos(v886) * 0.6)
		local v892 = CFrame.lookAt(v890, v890 + v891) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, v885.w >= 0 and 0.3 or -0.3)
		v_u_7.place(v885.m, v892)
		local v893 = p883 * 11 + v885.ph
		local v894 = (math.sin(v893) * 30 + 16) * 0.017453292519943295
		local v895 = v885.m:FindFirstChild("WingL")
		local v896 = v885.m:FindFirstChild("WingR")
		if not (v895 and v896) then
			continue
		end
		v896.CFrame = v892 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, v894) * v_u_12(0.55, 0.05, 0.05)
		v895.CFrame = v892 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -v894) * v_u_12(-0.55, 0.05, 0.05)
	end
end

	end
end

			local v55 = v46[2] - v47[2]
			local v56 = v46[3] - v47[3]
			local v57 = -v55
			local v58 = -v56
			return v52, v54, v50, math.atan2(v57, v58)
		end
		return p43[v44][2], p43[v44][3], 0
	end
}
local function v_u_68(p60, p61, p62) -- name: mix
	if p62 <= 0 then
		return p60
	end
	if p62 >= 1 then
		return p61
	end
	local v63 = {}
	for v64, v65 in pairs(p60) do
		v63[v64] = v65:Lerp(p61[v64] or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), p62)
	end
	for v66, v67 in pairs(p61) do
		if p60[v66] then
			continue
		end
		v63[v66] = (Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)):Lerp(v67, p62)
	end
	return v63
end
local function v_u_75(p69, p70, p71) -- name: blendIn
	if p71 <= 0 then
		return p69
	end
	local v72 = table.clone(p69)
	for v73, v74 in pairs(p70) do
		v72[v73] = (p69[v73] or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)):Lerp(v74, (math.min(p71, 1)))
	end
	return v72
end

function v_u_59.mirror(p82) -- name: mirror
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18
	local v83 = {}
	for v86, v85 in pairs(p82) do
		local v86
		if v86:sub(1, 5) == "Right" then
			v86 = "Left" .. v86:sub(6)
		elseif v86:sub(1, 4) == "Left" then
			v86 = "Right" .. v86:sub(5)
		end
		v83[v86] = v_u_18(v85.X, -v85.Y, -v85.Z)
	end
	return v83
end

		["LeftHip"] = v_u_18(v98 * -30 * p97, 0, 0)

	local v100 = p96 + 1.9
	local v101 = math.sin(v100)
	v99.RightKnee = v_u_18(-math.max(0, v101) * 55 * p97 - 6, 0, 0)
	local v102 = p96 + 1.9 + 3.141592653589793
	local v103 = math.sin(v102)
	v99.LeftKnee = v_u_18(-math.max(0, v103) * 55 * p97 - 6, 0, 0)
	v99.RightShoulder = v_u_18(v98 * -26 * p97, 0, 5)
	v99.LeftShoulder = v_u_18(v98 * 26 * p97, 0, -5)
	v99.RightElbow = v_u_18(14 + 10 * p97, 0, 0)

end

function v_u_59.punchK(p124, p125) -- name: punchK
	local v126 = p124 - p125
	if v126 < 0 or v126 > 0.55 then
		return 0
	end
	if v126 < 0.11 then
		local v127 = v126 / 0.11
		local v128 = math.clamp(v127, 0, 1)
		return 1 - (1 - v128) * (1 - v128)
	end
	if v126 < 0.2 then
		return 1
	end
	local v129 = (v126 - 0.2) / 0.35
	local v130 = math.clamp(v129, 0, 1)
	return 1 - v130 * v130 * (3 - 2 * v130)
end
function v_u_59.hitK(p131, p132, p133) -- name: hitK
	local v134 = p133 or 0.6
	local v135 = p131 - p132
	if v135 < 0 or v134 < v135 then
		return 0

		local v136 = v135 / 0.07
		local v137 = math.clamp(v136, 0, 1)
		return 1 - (1 - v137) * (1 - v137)
	end
	if v135 < 0.2 then
		return 1
	end
	local v138 = (v135 - 0.2) / (v134 - 0.2)
	local v139 = math.clamp(v138, 0, 1)
	return 1 - v139 * v139 * (3 - 2 * v139)
end

function v_u_59.safeEye(p325, p326, p327, p328) -- name: safeEye
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_59, (copy) v_u_321, (copy) v_u_324
	local v329 = p326 - p325
	if v329.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		return p326
	end
	if not p327 then
		p327 = {}
		local v330 = workspace:FindFirstChild("Game")
		if v330 then
			table.insert(p327, v330)
		end
		local v331 = v_u_59.active
		if v331 and v331.folder.Parent then
			local v332 = v331.folder
			table.insert(p327, v332)
		end
	end
	v_u_321.FilterDescendantsInstances = p327
	local v333 = v329.Unit
	local v334 = p325
	for _ = 1, 8 do
		local v335 = workspace:Raycast(p325, p326 - p325, v_u_321)
		if not v335 then
			return p326
		end
		if not v_u_324(v335.Instance) then
			local v336 = (v335.Position - v334):Dot(v333) - (p328 or 0.45)
			return v334 + v333 * math.max(0.3, v336)
		end
		p325 = v335.Position + v333 * 0.05
		if (p326 - p325):Dot(v333) > 0 then
			continue
		end
		return p326
	end
	return p326
end

	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18

		local v340 = v339.Unit.Y
		if math.abs(v340) > 0.999 then
			p338 = p338 + v_u_18(0, 0, -0.02 * v339.Magnitude)
		end
	end
	return CFrame.lookAt(p337, p338)
end

	for _, v390 in ipairs(v_u_1:GetPlayers()) do
		local v391 = v390.Character
		if v391 and (v391 ~= v389 and (p388 >= 1 and not p387.finished)) then
			v_u_386(p387, v391)
		else
			if not v391 or v391 == v389 then
				continue
			end
			for _, v392 in ipairs(v391:GetDescendants()) do
				if v392:IsA("BasePart") or v392:IsA("Decal") then
					if p388 < 1 and v390 == v_u_17 then
						continue
					end
					v392.LocalTransparencyModifier = p388
				else
					if p388 < 1 or not v_u_365(v392) then
						continue
					end
					if p387.was[v392] == nil then

						if v392:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
							v392:Clear()
						end
					end
					v392.Enabled = false
				end
			end
			local v393 = v391:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not v393 or p388 < 1 then
				break
			end
			if p387.was[v393] == nil then
				p387.was[v393] = v393.NameDisplayDistance
			end
			v393.NameDisplayDistance = 0
		end
	end
	if p388 < 1 then
		for v394, v395 in pairs(p387.was) do
			if not v394.Parent then
				continue
			end
			if v394:IsA("Humanoid") then
				v394.NameDisplayDistance = v395
			else

			end
		end
		table.clear(p387.was)
	end

local function v_u_462(p440, p441) -- name: stepStage
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_430, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_439, (copy) v_u_19
	if p440.finished then
		return
	else
		if p440.opts.cutIf then
			local v442 = p440.opts.cutIf
			local v443, v444 = pcall(v442)
			if v443 and v444 then
				p440.finish(false, true)
				return
			end
		end
		v_u_430(p440)
		if p440.started then
			local v445 = os.clock() - p440.startAt
			local v446 = p440.opts.debugAttr and v_u_3:IsStudio()
			if v446 then
				v446 = workspace:GetAttribute(p440.opts.debugAttr)
			end
			local v447 = type(v446) == "number"
			if v447 then
				if not p440.opts.debugCover then
					p440.cover.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				end
			else
				v446 = v445
			end
			p440.lastT = v446
			for _, v448 in ipairs(p440.cues) do
				if p440.fired[v448] or v448[1] > v446 then
					continue
				end
				p440.fired[v448] = true
				task.spawn(v448[2], p440)
			end
			if not p440.finished then
				local v449 = nil
				local v450 = nil
				if p440.opts.frame then
					local v451 = p440.opts.frame
					local v452, v453, v454 = pcall(v451, v446, p441, p440)
					if v452 then
						v450 = v454
						v449 = v453
					else
						p440.errors = p440.errors + 1
						if p440.errors == 1 then
							warn("[Cinematic.Kit] " .. tostring(v453))
						end
						if p440.errors > 30 then
							p440.finish(false)
							return
						end
					end
				end
				for _, v455 in pairs(p440.loops) do
					local v456 = v455.level
					local v457 = v455.target - v455.level
					local v458 = p441 * 4
					v455.level = v456 + v457 * math.min(1, v458)
					v455.sound.Volume = v455.base * v455.level
				end
				local v459 = p440.shakeAmt
				local v460 = -p441 * 7
				p440.shakeAmt = v459 * math.exp(v460)
				local v461 = workspace.CurrentCamera
				v461.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
				if v449 then
					v_u_439(p440, v449)
					if p440.shakeAmt > 0.01 then
						v449 = v449 * CFrame.Angles(v_u_19(math.noise(v446 * 25, 0.3) * 3 * p440.shakeAmt), v_u_19(math.noise(0.7, v446 * 25) * 3 * p440.shakeAmt), 0)
					end
					v461.CFrame = v449
					if v450 then
						v461.FieldOfView = v450
					end
				end
				if not v447 and (p440.opts.duration and p440.opts.duration <= v446) then
					p440.finish(false)
				end
			end
		else
			if os.clock() - p440.createdAt > (p440.opts.startTimeout or 40) then
				warn("[Cinematic.Kit] " .. p440.id .. " never started")
				p440.finish(false)
			end
			return
		end
	end
end

local function v_u_414(p398, p399) -- name: pathAt
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_60, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_15

	local v401 = v_u_60.head

		v402 = v401.CFrame

	end
	local v403 = (v402 * v_u_16(0, 0.15, -v_u_60.wrapR - 0.05)).Position
	local v404 = v_u_60.f
	local v405 = v_u_60.side
	local v406 = v400 + Vector3.new(0, 1.9, 0) - v404 * 0.9 + v405 * 0.5
	local v407 = v403 + v404 * 1.5 + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0) - v405 * 0.6
	local v408 = 1 - p398
	local v409 = v400 * (v408 * v408 * v408) + v406 * (3 * v408 * v408 * p398) + v407 * (3 * v408 * p398 * p398) + v403 * (p398 * p398 * p398)

		local v413 = p398 * 3.141592653589793 * 3
		v409 = v409 + (v412 + v_u_15(0, math.cos(v413) * 0.18 * v410, 0))
	end
	return v409
end

function v_u_28.cam(p667, p668) -- name: cam
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_666, (copy) v_u_28, (ref) v_u_60, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_16
	local v669, v670, v671 = (v_u_666[p667] or v_u_666.A)(p668, v_u_28.act(p668))
	if not v_u_60.low and v671 then
		local v672 = v_u_60.dof
		if not (v672 and v672.Parent) then
			v672 = Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect")
			v672.Name = "Chapter3IntroDOF"
			v672.Parent = v_u_2
			v_u_60.dof = v672
		end
		v672.FocusDistance = v671[1]
		v672.InFocusRadius = v671[2]
		v672.FarIntensity = v671[3]
		v672.NearIntensity = v671[4]
	end
	if v_u_60.nearRain then
		v_u_60.nearRain.CFrame = v_u_16(v669.Position + v669.LookVector * 5 + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
	end
	return v669, v670
end
local function v_u_676(p673) -- name: thunder
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_6

		["volume"] = p673
	}
	local v675 = {
		["pitch"] = 0.32,

		["volume"] = p673
	}

		v_u_6.play("Thunder", v674)
	else
		v_u_6.play("Break", v675 or v674)
	end
end
function v_u_28.cues() -- name: cues
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_60, (copy) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_676, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_44, (copy) v_u_16
	local v_u_677 = v_u_60.st
	local v678 = v_u_677.cue
	if v_u_5.SOUNDS.RainStreet then
		v_u_60.st.loop("RainStreet", 0.55)
	else
		v_u_60.st.loop("SewerRain", 0.55)
	end
	if v_u_60.run then
		for _, v679 in ipairs(v_u_11.cues(v_u_29.R1, v_u_60.run)) do
			v678(v679[1], v679[2])
		end
	end
	v678(v_u_29.BOLT, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_676
		v_u_676(0.3)
	end)
	v678(v_u_29.STOP, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_60, (ref) v_u_15, (ref) v_u_44
		v_u_6.play("Splash", {
			["pitch"] = 1.1,
			["volume"] = 0.5
		})
		v_u_7.burst(v_u_60.hero.root.Position - v_u_15(0, v_u_60.hero.height - 0.1, 0), "dust", 10, {
			["scale"] = 0.4,
			["color"] = nil,
			["color"] = v_u_44.splash
		})
	end)
	v678(v_u_29.GUST, function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_5, (ref) v_u_6
		local v680 = {
			["volume"] = 0.5
		}
		local v681 = {
			["pitch"] = 0.45,
			["volume"] = 0.2
		}
		if v_u_5.SOUNDS.Whoosh then
			v_u_6.play("Whoosh", v680)
		else
			v_u_6.play("Punch2", v681 or v680)

v_u_1.CHAPTERS = v10
function v_u_1.chapter() -- name: chapter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v12 = workspace:GetAttribute("Chapter")
	return v_u_1.CHAPTERS[v12] and v12 and v12 or 1
end
function v_u_1.ch(p13, p14) -- name: ch
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v15 = v_u_1.CHAPTERS[p14 or v_u_1.chapter()]
	if v15 then
		v15 = v15[p13]
	end
	if v15 == nil then
		v15 = v_u_1[p13]
	end
	return v15
end
function v_u_1.chDiff(p16, p17, p18) -- name: chDiff
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v19 = v_u_1.ch(p16, p18)
	if type(v19) == "table" then
		return v_u_1.byDiff(v19, p17 or (workspace:GetAttribute("Difficulty") or "Normal"))
	else
		return v19
	end
end
local v_u_20 = {
	[2] = "YardHelpersInfo",
	[3] = "SewerHelpersInfo",
	[4] = "CoveHelpersInfo"
}
local v_u_21 = {}
local function v_u_33(p22, p23) -- name: chapterHelper
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_21
	local v24 = p23 or v_u_1.chapter()
	local v25
	if p22 then
		v25 = v_u_20[v24]
	else
		v25 = p22
	end
	if not v25 then
		return nil
	end
	local v26 = v_u_21[v24]
	if v26 then
		return v26.TREE[p22.id], v26
	end
	if v24 == 2 then
		v26 = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild(v25))
		v_u_21[v24] = v26
	else
		local v27 = script.Parent:FindFirstChild(v25)
		local v28
		if v27 and v27:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local v29 = require
			v28, v26 = pcall(v29, v27)
		else
			v28 = false
			v26 = nil
		end
		if v28 then
			if type(v26) == "table" then
				local v30 = v26.TREE
				v28 = type(v30) == "table"
			else
				v28 = false
			end
		end
		if not v28 then
			return nil
		end
		local v31 = v26.image
		if type(v31) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end
		local v32 = v26.levelText
		if type(v32) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end
		v_u_21[v24] = v26
	end
	return v26.TREE[p22.id], v26
end
function v_u_1.upgradeDesc(p34, p35) -- name: upgradeDesc
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_1
	local v36 = v_u_33(p34, p35)
	if v36 then
		return v36.desc
	end
	local v37 = v_u_1.ch("UPGRADE_DESC", p35)
	return type(v37) == "table" and v37[p34.id] or p34.desc
end
function v_u_1.upgradeName(p38, p39) -- name: upgradeName
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_1
	local v40 = v_u_33(p38, p39)
	if v40 then
		return v40.name
	end
	local v41 = v_u_1.ch("UPGRADE_NAME", p39)
	return type(v41) == "table" and v41[p38.id] or p38.name
end
function v_u_1.upgradeImage(p42, p43, p44) -- name: upgradeImage
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_33
	local v45, v46 = v_u_33(p42, p44)
	if v45 then
		v45 = v46.image(p42.id)
	end
	return v45 or p43[p42.icon]
end
function v_u_1.upgradeValueText(p47, p48, p49) -- name: upgradeValueText
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_33, (copy) v_u_1
	local v50, v51 = v_u_33(p47, p49)
	if v50 then
		return v51.levelText(p47.id, p48)
	else
		return p47 and p47.ping and (p49 or v_u_1.chapter()) == 3 and (p48 >= 1 and "Set" or "Not set") or (p47 and p47.ping and (p49 or v_u_1.chapter()) == 4 and (p48 >= 1 and "Used" or "Unused") or (p47 and p47.ping and (p48 >= 1 and "Marked" or "Hidden") or nil))
	end
end
function v_u_1.notice(p52, p53, p54) -- name: notice
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v55 = v_u_1.ch("NOTICES", p54)
	if type(v55) == "table" then
		p53 = v55[p52] or p53
	end
	return p53
end

function v_u_1.material(p62) -- name: material

function v_u_1.teamSize(p64) -- name: teamSize
	local v65 = game:GetService("Players")
	local v66 = v65.LocalPlayer
	if p64 == nil and v66 then
		p64 = v66:GetAttribute("DuelSide")
	end
	local v67 = 0
	for _, v68 in ipairs(v65:GetPlayers()) do
		if v68:GetAttribute("AdminVisit") or p64 ~= nil and v68:GetAttribute("DuelSide") ~= p64 then
			continue
		end
		v67 = v67 + 1
	end
	return math.max(1, v67)
end

function v_u_1.cubeHp(p92, p93, p94, p95) -- name: cubeHp
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_91
	local v96 = 1 + (v_u_1.chDiff("TEAM_HP_STEP", p93, p95) or 0) * (math.max(1, p94 or 1) - 1)
	local v97 = v_u_91(p92, p95)
	local v98 = v_u_1.chDiff("HP_MULT", p93, p95) or 1
	local v99 = v97 * (type(v98) == "table" and (v98[p92] or 1) or v98) * v96 + 0.5
	local v100 = math.floor(v99)
	return math.max(1, v100)
end
function v_u_1.cubeValue(p101, p102, p103) -- name: cubeValue
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_91, (copy) v_u_1
	local v104 = v_u_91(p101, p103)
	local v105 = v_u_1.chDiff("HP_MULT", p102, p103) or 1
	local v106 = v104 * (type(v105) == "table" and (v105[p101] or 1) or v105) + 0.5
	local v107 = math.floor(v106)
	return math.max(1, v107) * (v_u_1.chDiff("VALUE_MULT", p102, p103) or 1)
end

function v_u_3.short(p941) -- name: short
	if p941 >= 1000000 then
		local v942 = string.format
		local v943 = p941 / 100000
		return v942("%gM", math.floor(v943) / 10)
	end
	if p941 < 1000 then
		local v944 = math.floor(p941)
		return tostring(v944)
	end
	local v945 = string.format
	local v946 = p941 / 100
	return v945("%gK", math.floor(v946) / 10)
end

function v_u_3.makeGlove(p959, p960, p961, p962) -- name: makeGlove
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_958
	local v963 = v_u_3.find("Glove", p959) or v_u_3.GLOVES[1]
	local v964 = p962 or 1
	local v965 = {}
	for _, v966 in ipairs(v963.parts(p960)) do
		local v967 = Instance.new("Part")
		v967.Name = v966.name
		if v966.shape then
			v967.Shape = v966.shape
		end
		if v966.ellipsoid then
			local v968 = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
			v968.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
			v968.Parent = v967
		end
		v967.Size = v966.size * v964
		v967.Color = v966.skin and (p961 or Color3.fromRGB(234, 184, 146)) or v966.color
		v967.Material = v966.material
		v967.Transparency = v966.transparency or 0
		v967.Reflectance = v966.reflectance or 0
		v967.CanCollide = false
		v967.CanQuery = false
		v967.CanTouch = false
		v967.CastShadow = false
		v967.Massless = true
		v967.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		v967.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		if v966.rainbow then
			v967:SetAttribute("Phase", v966.rainbow)
			v_u_1:AddTag(v967, v_u_3.RAINBOW_TAG)
		end
		if v966.anim then
			local v969 = v966.anim
			v967:SetAttribute("Mx", v969.k)
			v967:SetAttribute("MxCF", v966.cf)
			v967:SetAttribute("MxScale", v964)
			v967:SetAttribute("MxSide", p960)
			v967:SetAttribute("MxSz", v967.Size)
			v967:SetAttribute("MxCol", v967.Color)
			v967:SetAttribute("MxW", v969.w or 1)
			for v970, v971 in pairs(v_u_958) do
				if v969[v971] == nil then
					continue
				end
				v967:SetAttribute(v970, v969[v971])
			end
		elseif v963.vault and v966.name == "Fist" then
			v967:SetAttribute("MxSide", p960)
			v967:SetAttribute("MxSize", v966.size)
		end
		local v972 = v966.cf
		if v964 ~= 1 then
			v972 = v972 - v972.Position + v972.Position * v964
		end
		table.insert(v965, {
			["part"] = v967,
			["cf"] = v972,
			["spec"] = v966
		})
	end
	return v965, v963
end
function v_u_3.hasCuff(p973) -- name: hasCuff
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v974 = v_u_3.find("Glove", p973)
	if not v974 then
		return false
	end
	for _, v975 in ipairs(v974.parts(1)) do
		if v975.name ~= "Cuff" then
			continue
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end
local function v_u_982(...) -- name: cs
	local v976 = { ... }
	if #v976 == 1 then
		return ColorSequence.new(v976[1])
	end
	local v977 = {}
	for v978, v979 in ipairs(v976) do
		local v980 = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new
		local v981 = (v978 - 1) / (#v976 - 1)
		table.insert(v977, v980(v981, v979))
	end
	return ColorSequence.new(v977)
end

end

	local v1000 = math.cos(v994)
	local v1001 = math.sin(v994)
	local v1002 = Vector3.new(0, v1000, v1001)

	local v1004 = {}
	for v1005, v1006 in ipairs({
		{ 1, -1 },

		local v1007 = {

			["x1"] = v1002,
			["c0"] = v1003 * v1006[1],

		}

	return v1004

local function v_u_89(p73, p74) -- name: calibrate
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_71, (copy) v_u_72
	local v75 = v_u_71[p74.Texture] or v_u_72
	if v75.size then
		local v76 = {}
		for _, v77 in ipairs(p73.Size.Keypoints) do
			local v78 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
			local v79 = v77.Time
			local v80 = v77.Value * v75.size
			local v81 = v77.Envelope * v75.size
			table.insert(v76, v78(v79, v80, v81))
		end
		p73.Size = NumberSequence.new(v76)
	end
	if v75.le and p73.LightEmission > v75.le then
		p73.LightEmission = v75.le
	end
	if p74.Brightness == nil then
		p73.Brightness = v75.bright or 1
	end
	if v75.fade then

		for v83, v84 in ipairs(p73.Transparency.Keypoints) do
			local v85 = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new

local function v_u_49(p28, p29, p30) -- name: addRow

	local v38 = -v31.LIMIT + v32.gap
	local v39 = v31.LIMIT - v32.gap

	p28.lastRow = p30
	local v42 = -v31.LIMIT + v32.pitch / 2
	while v42 <= v31.LIMIT do
		local v43 = v42 - v41
		if math.abs(v43) >= v32.gap then
			local v44 = v32.r
			p28.id = p28.id + 1

function v_u_1.track(p98, p99, p100) -- name: track
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_92
	local v_u_101 = v_u_1.tuning(p99)
	local v102 = v_u_101.PHYS
	local v103 = {
		["T"] = nil,
		["rng"] = nil,
		["id"] = 0,
		["lane"] = 0,

		["T"] = v_u_101
	}
	local v104 = tonumber(p98) or 1

	v103.hazards = {}
	v103.rows = {}
	v103.encounters = {}
	v103.vRef = v102.cap * (1 + v102.capRhythm) * (1 + v_u_101.GEAR.sail * v_u_101.GEAR.max)
	local v106 = 0
	local v107 = {}
	for v108, v109 in ipairs(v_u_101.ZONES) do
		local v110 = v109.len * v_u_101.LEN
		local v111 = v109.scripts
		v103.rng = v103.rng * 48271 % 2147483647
		local v112 = v103.rng / 2147483647 * #v111
		local v113 = v111[math.floor(v112) + 1]
		local v114 = v110 / (#v113 + 0.5)
		for v115, v116 in ipairs(v113) do
			local v117 = v106 + v114 * (v115 - 0.5)
			v103.rng = v103.rng * 48271 % 2147483647
			local v118 = v117 + (v103.rng / 2147483647 - 0.5) * v114 * 0.12
			v_u_92[v116](v103, v118, v114)
		end
		local v119 = {
			["id"] = v108,
			["name"] = v109.name,
			["s0"] = v106,

		table.insert(v107, v119)
		v106 = v106 + v110
	end
	table.sort(v103.hazards, function(p120, p121)
		if p120.s == p121.s then
			return p120.id < p121.id

local function v_u_152(p148) -- name: countActive

	p148.fighters = math.max(1, v150)

function v_u_1.join(p153, p154, p155) -- name: join

end
function v_u_1.leave(p158, p159) -- name: leave
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_152
	if p158.crew[p159] then
		p158.crew[p159] = nil
		if p158.helm == p159 then
			p158.helm = nil
		end
		if p158.swap and p158.swap.from == p159 then
			p158.swap.from = nil
		end
		local v160 = table.find(p158.order, p159)
		if v160 then
			table.remove(p158.order, v160)
		end
		for _, v161 in ipairs(p158.ents) do
			if v161.who ~= p159 then
				continue
			end
			v161.who = nil
		end
		table.sort(p158.order)
		p158.n = #p158.order
		v_u_152(p158)
	end
end

local function v_u_440(p428, p429, p430) -- name: pickOwner

		v431 = p428.helm

			continue
		end

	end

	local v435 = false
	for v436 = 1, 2 do
		for v437 = 1, v434 do

		local v770 = p750.track.seed
		local v771 = tonumber(v770) or 1
		v768(p750, v769[math.floor(v771) % #p750.order + 1], nil, p751)
	end
end
function v_u_1.step(p773, p774, p775) -- name: step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_418, (copy) v_u_152, (copy) v_u_772, (copy) v_u_221, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_675, (copy) v_u_257, (copy) v_u_480, (copy) v_u_499, (copy) v_u_517, (copy) v_u_541, (copy) v_u_553, (copy) v_u_561, (copy) v_u_628, (copy) v_u_698, (copy) v_u_637, (copy) v_u_702, (copy) v_u_709
	local v776 = {}
	if p773.over then
		return v776
	end
	p773.t = p773.t + p774
	v_u_418(p773, p775, v776)
	v_u_152(p773)
	v_u_772(p773, v776)
	local v777 = p773.T
	local v778 = p773.rhythm - v777.RHYTHM.decay * p774
	p773.rhythm = math.max(0, v778)
	local v779 = p773.s
	local v780 = p773.x
	p773.prevS = v779
	p773.prevX = v780
	local v781 = v_u_221
	local v782 = p773.helm
	if v782 then
		v782 = p773.crew[p773.helm]
	end
	local v783
	if v782 then
		local v784 = v782.steer
		v783 = math.abs(v784) <= 0.05 and 0 or v782.steer
	else
		v783 = 0
	end
	v781(p773, p774, v783)
	local v785 = v_u_1.zoneAt(p773.track, p773.s)
	if v785 ~= p773.zone then
		p773.zone = v785
		local v786 = {
			["zone"] = v785,
			["name"] = p773.track.zones[v785].name,
			["s"] = p773.s,
			["kind"] = "SeaZone",
			["t"] = p773.t
		}
		table.insert(v776, v786)
	end
	if not (p773.boss or p773.fogS) then
		v_u_675(p773)
		if p773.s >= p773.track.length then
			local v787 = v777.BOSS
			local v788 = v_u_257(p773, "Cutter", "enter", 1, p773.s + v787.enter, p773.x)
			v788.hp = v787.hp * (1 + v787.crewHp * (p773.fighters - 1))
			v788.max = v788.hp
			v788.t1 = p773.t + v787.enterTime
			v788.turn = 0
			p773.boss = v788
			local v789 = {
				["phase"] = "start",
				["hp"] = nil,
				["max"] = nil,
				["hp"] = v788.hp,
				["max"] = v788.max,
				["kind"] = "SeaBoss",
				["t"] = p773.t
			}
			table.insert(v776, v789)
			for _, v790 in ipairs(p773.ents) do
				if v790.kind ~= "Heli" and (v790.kind ~= "Patrol" and v790.kind ~= "Hooker" or v790.state == "hooked") then
					continue
				end
				v790.state = "leave"
				v790.parry = false
				v790.t1 = p773.t
			end
		end
	end
	local v791 = v_u_480(p773)
	for _, v792 in ipairs(p773.ents) do
		if v792.dead then
			continue
		end
		if v792.kind == "Patrol" then
			v_u_499(p773, v792, p774, v776, v791)
		elseif v792.kind == "Hooker" then
			v_u_517(p773, v792, p774, v776, v791)
		elseif v792.kind == "Heli" then
			v_u_541(p773, v792, p774, v776)
		elseif v792.kind == "Net" then
			v_u_553(p773, v792, v776)
		elseif v792.kind == "Mine" then
			v_u_561(p773, v792, v776)
		else
			if v792.kind ~= "Cutter" then
				continue
			end
			v_u_628(p773, v792, p774, v776)
		end
	end
	v_u_698(p773, v776)
	v_u_637(p773, v776)
	v_u_702(p773)
	if p773.boss and p773.boss.dead then
		p773.boss = nil
	end
	v_u_709(p773, v776)
	return v776
end
function v_u_1.predict(p793, p794, p795) -- name: predict
	p793.t = p793.t + p794
	local v796 = p793.rhythm - p793.T.RHYTHM.decay * p794
	p793.rhythm = math.max(0, v796)
	local v797 = (tonumber(p795) or 0) + p793.steerOthers
	local v798 = math.min(1, v797)
	local v799 = math.max(-1, v798)
	local v800 = p793.T
	local _ = v800.PHYS
	local v801 = p793.vx
	local v802 = v799 * v800.BOAT.turn * p793.pace
	local v803 = v800.BOAT.turnAccel * p793.pace * p794
	local v804
	if v801 < v802 then
		local v805 = v801 + v803
		v804 = math.min(v805, v802)
	else
		local v806 = v801 - v803
		v804 = math.max(v806, v802)
	end
	p793.vx = v804
	p793.x = p793.x + p793.vx * p794
	local v807 = p793.x
	if math.abs(v807) > v800.LIMIT then
		local v808 = p793.x
		local v809 = -v800.LIMIT
		local v810 = v800.LIMIT
		local v811 = math.min(v810, v808)
		p793.x = math.max(v809, v811)
		p793.vx = 0
	end
	p793.s = p793.s + p793.vs * p794
	if p793.debt > 0 then
		local v812 = p793.debt
		local v813 = p793.vs * p794 * 0.3
		local v814 = math.min(v812, v813)
		p793.debt = p793.debt - v814
		p793.s = p793.s - v814
	end
	if p793.debtX ~= 0 then
		local v815 = p793.debtX
		local v816 = -p793.T.BOAT.xPay * p794
		local v817 = v815 * (1 - math.exp(v816))
		p793.debtX = p793.debtX - v817
		local v818 = p793.x + v817
		local v819 = -p793.T.LIMIT
		local v820 = p793.T.LIMIT
		local v821 = math.min(v820, v818)
		p793.x = math.max(v819, v821)
	end
	local v822 = p793.hist
	local v823 = {
		["t"] = p793.t,
		["s"] = p793.s,
		["x"] = p793.x + p793.debtX,
		["vx"] = p793.vx
	}
	table.insert(v822, v823)
	if #v822 > 120 then
		table.remove(v822, 1)
	end
	return p793
end
function v_u_1.apply(p824, p825, p826) -- name: apply
	local v827 = p824.hist
	local v828 = nil
	local v829 = p826 or 0.3
	for v830 = #v827, 1, -1 do
		if v827[v830].t > p825.t then
			continue
		end
		v828 = v827[v830]
	end
	local v831 = p824.t - p825.t
	local v832 = math.max(0, v831)
	local v833
	if v828 then
		v833 = p825.s - v828.s
	else
		v833 = p825.s + p825.vs * v832 - p824.s
	end
	local v834
	if v828 then
		v834 = p825.x - v828.x
	else
		v834 = p825.x + p825.vx * v832 - (p824.x + p824.debtX)
	end
	local v835 = v833 * v829
	local v836 = v834 * v829
	if v835 >= 0 then
		p824.s = p824.s + v835
		p824.debt = 0
	else
		p824.debt = -v835
	end
	p824.debtX = p824.debtX + v836
	for _, v837 in ipairs(v827) do
		v837.x = v837.x + v836
		v837.s = v837.s + math.max(0, v835)
	end
	p824.vs = p825.vs
	if p825.crew and #p825.crew > 1 then
		local v838 = p824.T.BOAT
		local v839 = p824.steerOthers
		local v840 = p825.vx
		local v841
		if v828 then
			v841 = v828.vx
		else
			v841 = p824.vx
		end
		local v842 = v839 + (v840 - v841) / v838.turn * v838.steerBlend
		local v843 = math.min(2, v842)
		p824.steerOthers = math.max(-2, v843)
	else
		p824.steerOthers = 0
	end
	p824.vx = p824.vx + (p825.vx - p824.vx) * v829
	p824.hull = p825.hull
	p824.rhythm = p825.rhythm
	p824.zone = p825.zone
end

		local v992 = v972.ents

		v993.side = math.floor(v996) - 1

function v_u_1.flatDir(p363, p364) -- name: flatDir
	if typeof(p363) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(p364) ~= "Vector3" then

	local v370 = v366 / v368
	return Vector3.new(v369, 0, v370)
end

function v_u_76.chompAt(p95, p96) -- name: chompAt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_76

		v97 = p95
	end
	if not v97 or p96 < v97 then
		return nil
	end
	local v99, v100, v101, v102, v103, v104, v105 = v_u_76.chompTimes(p95)
	if v105 <= p96 then
		return nil
	end
	if p96 < v99 then
		local v106 = (p96 - v97) / (v99 - v97)
		local v107 = v106 * 4
		local v108 = math.clamp(v107, 0, 1)

		local v134 = tonumber(v133) or 0
		local v135 = math.floor(v134)

function v_u_76.route(p164, p165, p166, p167) -- name: route
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_76, (copy) v_u_163
	local v168 = v_u_76.region(p164, p165)
	local v169 = v_u_76.region(p166, p167)
	local v_u_170 = {}
	local function v177(p171) -- name: push
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_170
		local v172 = v_u_170[#v_u_170]
		if v172 then
			local v173 = v172[1] - p171[1]
			if math.abs(v173) < 0.05 then
				local v174 = v172[2] - p171[2]
				if math.abs(v174) < 0.05 then

				end
			end

		v177({ p164, p165 })
		v177({ p166, p167 })
		return v_u_170
	end
	local v178, v179, v180 = v_u_163(p164, p165)
	local v181, v182, v183 = v_u_163(p166, p167)
	if v168 == "lair" and v169 == "lair" then
		v177(v178[1])
		v177(v178[2])
		v177(v181[2])
		v177(v181[1])
		return v_u_170
	end
	for _, v184 in ipairs(v178) do
		v177(v184)
	end
	local v185 = v_u_76.BANDIT_LANE
	local v186
	if v179 == "N" then
		v186 = -v185
	else
		v186 = v185
	end
	if v182 == "N" then
		v185 = -v185
	end
	if v179 ~= v182 then
		local v187 = v_u_76.BRIDGE_X[1]
		local v188 = (1 / 0)
		for _, v189 in ipairs(v_u_76.BRIDGE_X) do
			local v190 = v180 - v189
			local v191 = math.abs(v190)

				continue
			end

			v188 = v193
		end

		v177({ v187, v185 })
	end
	v177({ v183, v185 })
	for v194 = #v181, 1, -1 do

		if math.abs(v200) <= 0.0001 then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v195, v198)
	end
	if #v_u_170 > 1 then
		local v201 = v_u_170[#v_u_170]
		table.insert(v195, v201)
	end

end

function v_u_76.bubbleLen(p241) -- name: bubbleLen

function v_u_76.bubbleAt(p261, p262) -- name: bubbleAt
	local v263 = p262 - p261.t0
	local v264 = p261.from
	local v265 = p261.to
	if v263 < p261.inflate then
		local v266 = v264[1]
		local v267 = v264[2]
		local v268 = v264[3]
		local v269 = v263 / p261.inflate
		return "inflate", v266, v267, v268, math.clamp(v269, 0, 1)
	else
		local v270 = v263 - p261.inflate
		if v270 < p261.fly then
			local v271 = v270 / p261.fly
			local v272 = v271 * 3.141592653589793 * 3
			local v273 = math.sin(v272) * 0.25 * (1 - v271)
			local v274
			if p261.via then
				local v275 = p261.via
				local v276 = v275[1] - v264[1]
				local v277 = v275[2] - v264[2]
				local v278 = v275[3] - v264[3]
				local v279 = v276 * v276 + v277 * v277 + v278 * v278
				local v280 = math.sqrt(v279)
				local v281 = p261.via
				local v282 = v265[1] - v281[1]
				local v283 = v265[2] - v281[2]
				local v284 = v265[3] - v281[3]
				local v285 = v282 * v282 + v283 * v283 + v284 * v284
				local v286 = v280 + math.sqrt(v285)
				local v287 = v271 * v286
				if v286 > 0 and v287 < v280 then
					v265 = p261.via
					v274 = v287 / math.max(v280, 1e-6)
				else
					v264 = p261.via
					local v288 = v287 - v280
					local v289 = v286 - v280
					v274 = v288 / math.max(v289, 1e-6)
				end
			else
				v274 = v271
			end
			local v290 = v264[1]
			local v291 = v290 + (v265[1] - v290) * v274
			local v292 = v264[2]
			local v293 = v292 + (v265[2] - v292) * v274 + v273
			local v294 = v264[3]
			return "fly", v291, v293, v294 + (v265[3] - v294) * v274, v271
		else
			local v295 = v270 - p261.fly
			if v295 < p261.stick then
				return "stick", v265[1], v265[2], v265[3], v295 / p261.stick
			else
				return "pop", v265[1], v265[2], v265[3], 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function v_u_76.sector(p297, p298, p299) -- name: sector

		local v36 = v_u_1.pass(v35)

		if not p31[v35] then
			continue
		end
		v34 = v34 + v37
	end
	local v38 = tonumber(p32)
	if not v38 or v38 <= 0 then
		v38 = v_u_1.PASS_PACK.price
	end
	if v33 <= 0 or v34 <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	local v39 = v_u_1.PASS_PACK.price
	local v40 = math.min(v38, v39) * v34 / v33 * v_u_1.PACK_GEMS_PER_ROBUX
	return math.floor(v40)
end

	if p68 == nil then

function v_u_1.isOnSale(p70) -- name: isOnSale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_67, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_66
	if p70 ~= nil then
		local v71 = v_u_67
		if v71 then
			v71 = workspace:GetAttribute("Duel") == true
		end
		if not v71 then
			if v_u_67 and not v_u_1.inChapter(p70) then
				return false
			end
			if v_u_67 and (p70.noInsane and workspace:GetAttribute("Difficulty") == "Insane") then
				return false
			end
			if v_u_66 and workspace:GetAttribute("DebugOffers") == true then
				return true
			end
			local v72
			if p70.id == 0 then
				v72 = false
			else
				local v73 = v_u_67 and p70.live
				if v73 then
					v73 = workspace:GetAttribute(p70.live) ~= true
				end
				v72 = not v73
			end
			return v72
		end
	end
	return false
end
function v_u_1.onSale(p74) -- name: onSale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v75 = {}
	for _, v76 in ipairs(p74 or {}) do
		if not v_u_1.isOnSale(v76) then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v75, v76)
	end
	return v75
end

function v_u_1.sortPasses(p77) -- name: sortPasses
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v_u_78 = {}
	for v79, v80 in ipairs(v_u_1.PASS_ORDER) do
		v_u_78[v80] = v79
	end
	table.sort(p77, function(p81, p82)
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_78
		local v83 = v_u_78[p81.key] or 99
		local v84 = v_u_78[p82.key] or 99
		if v83 == v84 then
			return p81.key < p82.key
		else
			return v83 < v84
		end
	end)
	return p77
end

function v_u_1.gems(p88, p89, p90) -- name: gems
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	local v91 = 1
	for _, v92 in ipairs(v_u_1.PASSES) do
		if not (v92.gemMult and v_u_1.has(p88, v92.key)) then
			continue
		end
		v91 = v91 * v92.gemMult
	end
	if p88 and p88:GetAttribute("FriendBonus") then
		v91 = v91 * v_u_1.FRIEND_MULT
	end
	if p88 and (p88:GetAttribute("GemBoost") and not p90) then
		v91 = v91 * v_u_1.BOOST_MULT
	end
	local v93 = p89 * (v91 + (p88 and p88:GetAttribute("EnchantGems") or 0)) + 0.5
	return math.floor(v93)
end

local function v_u_116(p100, p101, p102, p103, p104) -- name: reachBottom

function v_u_189.sense(p288, p289, p290, p291) -- name: sense

function v_u_189.checkFeet(p572, p573, p574, p575) -- name: checkFeet

function v_u_189.gait(p597, p598, p599, p600) -- name: gait
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_32, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_57, (copy) v_u_61, (copy) v_u_58, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_62, (copy) v_u_63, (copy) v_u_64
	local v601 = p597.tg
	local v602 = p597.ps
	local v603 = p597.spd
	local v604 = p597.moving
	local v605 = p599.Position.Y
	local v606 = p597.F
	local v607 = p597.legMode
	local v608 = p597.climbing
	local v609

		v609 = 0
	else

	local v613 = v_u_28(0.28 + 0.035 * v603, 0.28, 0.44)
	local v614 = v604 and v_u_28(v603 * v612 / v613, 0.8, 7) or v_u_26(v_u_25(p597.yawRate), 3.4) * 1.2 + 2.6

	p597.f = v614
	local v615 = v604 and (v612 / v614 * 0.5 or 0) or 0
	local v616 = p597.vel.X
	local v617 = p597.vel.Z
	local v618 = p597.air

		v618 = not v608
	end
	p597:checkFeet(p598, p599, p600)
	local v619 = v604
	for v620 = 1, 4 do
		local v621 = v607[v620]

			v604 = true
		else
			if v621 ~= 0 then
				continue
			end
			local v622 = p599 * v_u_4(p597.hx[v620], 0, p597.hz[v620])
			local v623 = p597.P[v620].X - (v622.X + v616 * v615)
			local v624 = p597.P[v620].Z - (v622.Z + v617 * v615)
			local v625 = v_u_29(v623 * v623 + v624 * v624)

			end

		end
	end
	if v604 then
		p597.ph = (p597.ph + v614 * p598) % 1
	end
	if p597.dig then
		p597.digPh = (p597.digPh + 3 * p598) % 1
	end
	if p597.dance then
		p597.danceT = p597.danceT + p598
	end
	if v608 then
		p597.cPh = (p597.cPh + p598 * (p597.cPhase == "mantle" and 6 or 4.5)) % 1
	end
	local v626 = 0
	if v607[1] == 1 then
		v626 = v626 + 1
	end
	if v607[2] == 1 then
		v626 = v626 + 1
	end
	if v607[3] == 1 then

function v_u_189.boneDir(p805, p806, p807, p808) -- name: boneDir
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_23
	local v809 = p805.bw[p806]
	local v810
	if v809 > 0.001 then
		local v811 = (Vector3.new(-0, -1, -0)):Lerp(-p807.UpVector, v809)
		local v812 = v811.Magnitude
		v810 = v812 < 0.0001 and Vector3.new(-0, -1, -0) or v811 / v812
	else
		v810 = Vector3.new(-0, -1, -0)
	end
	local v813 = p808:Cross(v810)
	local v814 = p807.LookVector
	local v815 = v813.Magnitude
	if v815 >= 0.0001 then
		v814 = v813 / v815
	end
	local v816 = p805.al[p806]
	return v810 * v_u_24(v816) + v814 * v_u_23(v816)
end
function v_u_189.floorGuard(p817, p818, p819, p820, p821, p822, p823) -- name: floorGuard
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_58
	local v824 = p817.cy[p818] + 0.07
	if v824 <= p821.Y then
		return p821, p822
	end
	local v825 = p820 - p819
	local v826 = v825.Magnitude
	local v827
	if v826 < 0.0001 then
		v827 = nil
	else
		v827 = v825 / v826
	end
	if v827 == nil then
		return p821, p822
	end
	local v828 = p823 * v_u_58[p818]
	local v829 = v828 - v827 * v828:Dot(v827)
	local v830 = v829.Magnitude
	local v831
	if v830 < 0.0001 then
		v831 = nil
	else
		v831 = v829 / v830
	end
	if v831 == nil then
		return p821, p822
	end
	local v832 = p819 + v827 * (p821 - p819):Dot(v827)
	local v833 = (p821 - v832).Magnitude
	local v834 = 0
	local v835 = 1
	for _ = 1, 5 do
		local v836 = (v834 + v835) * 0.5
		local v837 = p822:Lerp(v831, v836)
		local v838 = v837.Magnitude
		local v839
		if v838 < 0.0001 then
			v839 = v831
		else
			v839 = v837 / v838
		end
		if v824 <= (v832 + v839 * v833).Y then
			v835 = v836
		else
			v834 = v836
		end
	end
	local v840 = p822:Lerp(v831, v835)
	local v841 = v840.Magnitude
	if v841 >= 0.0001 then
		v831 = v840 / v841
	end
	return v832 + v831 * v833, v831
end

local function v334(p329) -- name: timeAgo
	local v330 = tonumber(p329)
	if v330 then
		local v331 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - v330
		local v332 = math.floor(v331)
		if v332 < 45 then
			return "just now"
		elseif v332 < 3600 then
			local v333 = v332 // 60
			return math.max(1, v333) .. "m ago"
		elseif v332 < 86400 then
			return v332 // 3600 .. "h ago"
		elseif v332 < 5184000 then
			return v332 // 86400 .. "d ago"
		else
			return DateTime.fromUnixTimestamp((math.floor(v330))):FormatLocalTime("D MMM YYYY", "en-us")
		end
	else
		return "\226\128\148"
	end
end

local function v_u_552(p545, p546) -- name: fmt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_42
	if p545 == "Wins" then
		return v_u_42(p546) .. (p546 == 1 and " win" or " wins")
	elseif p545 == "Blocks" then
		return v_u_42(p546)
	elseif p545 == "PlayTime" then
		local v547 = math.floor(p546)
		local v548 = math.max(0, v547)
		return string.format("%dh %02dm", v548 // 3600, v548 % 3600 // 60)
	else
		local v549 = p546 / 10
		local v550 = math.floor(v549)
		local v551 = math.max(0, v550)
		if v551 >= 3600 then
			return string.format("%d:%02d:%02d", v551 // 3600, v551 % 3600 // 60, v551 % 60)
		else
			return string.format("%d:%02d", v551 // 60, v551 % 60)
		end
	end
end

local function v_u_405(p383) -- name: stepRivets
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_63, (copy) v_u_333, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_300, (copy) v_u_318, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_46, (copy) v_u_44, (copy) v_u_12

	if v_u_63() then
		v384 = nil
	else
		v384 = v_u_333(v_u_24.CFrame.Position, v_u_24.CFrame.LookVector) or nil
	end
	v_u_300.aim = v384
	for _, v385 in pairs(v_u_300.live) do
		local v386 = p383 - v385.t0

				continue
			end

			local v390 = v_u_300.nailed

			if #v_u_300.nailed <= 14 then
				continue
			end

		elseif v387 < -0.1 then

			v385.model:Destroy()
		else

			if v386 < 0.16 then
				local v392 = v386 / 0.16
				local v393 = v392 * 3.141592653589793 / 2
				local v394 = math.sin(v393) * 0.5

			else

			local v399

local function v_u_452(p427, p428) -- name: stepView
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_123, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_130, (copy) v_u_38, (copy) v_u_165, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_4
	local v429 = p427.fly
	if v429 then
		local v430 = (p428 - v429.t0) / v429.secs
		if v430 >= 1 then
			p427.fly = nil
			if v429.water then
				v_u_123.at("splash", v429.to, nil, 24)
				v_u_14.playAt("Splash", v429.to, {
					["volume"] = 1.3
				})
				v_u_130(p427, v_u_38(v429.to) * CFrame.Angles(0, p427.yaw, 0))
			else
				v_u_165(p427, v429.to)
			end
		else
			local v431 = v_u_18.arcAt(v429.from, v429.to, v429.apex, (math.max(v430, 0)))
			local v432 = v429.still and 0 or math.max(v430, 0) * v429.spin
			v_u_130(p427, v_u_38(v431) * CFrame.Angles(v432 * 0.8, p427.yaw + v432 * 0.3, v432))
			return
		end
	else
		local v433 = p427.tide
		if v433 then
			local v434 = (p428 - v433.t0) / v433.secs
			if v434 >= 1 then
				p427.tide = nil
				v_u_165(p427, v433.to)
			else
				local v435 = math.max(v434, 0)
				local v436 = v435 * v435 * (3 - 2 * v435)
				local v437 = v433.from:Lerp(v433.to, v436)
				local v438
				if v_u_10.ReducedMotionEnabled == true and true or v_u_4:GetAttribute("OptNoShake") == true then
					v438 = 0
				else
					local v439 = p428 * 5
					v438 = math.sin(v439) * 0.14
				end
				local v440 = v_u_130
				local v441 = v_u_38(v437.X, v437.Y + v438, v437.Z)
				local v442 = CFrame.Angles
				local v443 = p428 * 3
				local v444 = math.sin(v443) * 0.12
				local v445 = p427.yaw
				local v446 = p428 * 2.3
				v440(p427, v441 * v442(v444, v445, math.cos(v446) * 0.12))
			end
		else
			local v447 = p427.bounce
			if v447 then
				local v448 = os.clock() - v447.t0
				if v448 >= 0.62 then
					p427.bounce = nil
					v_u_130(p427, v_u_38(v447.pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, p427.yaw, 0))
					return
				end
				local v449
				if v_u_10.ReducedMotionEnabled == true and true or v_u_4:GetAttribute("OptNoShake") == true then
					v449 = 0
				else
					local v450 = v448 / 0.62 * 3.141592653589793 * 2.5
					local v451 = math.sin(v450)
					v449 = math.abs(v451) * 0.75 * (1 - v448 / 0.62) ^ 2
				end
				v_u_130(p427, v_u_38(v447.pos.X, v447.pos.Y + v449, v447.pos.Z) * CFrame.Angles(v449 * 0.5, p427.yaw, -v449 * 0.3))
			end
			return
		end
	end

local function v_u_627(p622, p623) -- name: gearValue
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_53
	local v624 = v_u_19.tuning(v_u_53("Difficulty"))
	if p622 == "hull" then
		local v625 = v624.HULL.base + v624.HULL.perLevel * p623
		return tostring(v625)
	end

		return "x" .. string.format("%.1f", 1 + v624.GEAR.ram * p623)

	return "+" .. math.floor(v626) .. "%"
end

		function v_u_64.waitFirstDraw() -- name: waitFirstDraw

				v_u_387.Parent = v_u_4:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

				local v_u_390 = nil
				v_u_390 = v_u_3.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_64, (copy) v_u_389, (ref) v_u_390, (ref) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_388, (copy) v_u_387

							v_u_4:SetAttribute("Cinematic", false)

		end

function v_u_23.lines(p385, p386) -- name: lines
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12, (ref) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_4
	local v387 = nil
	for v388, v389 in ipairs(v_u_12) do
		if v389[1] > p385 or p385 >= v389[1] + v389[2] then
			continue
		end
		v387 = v388
	end
	if v387 == v_u_25.lineShown then
		return
	else
		v_u_25.lineShown = v387
		if v387 then
			local v390 = v_u_12[v387]
			local v391 = v_u_3:IsStudio()
			if v391 then
				local v392 = workspace:GetAttribute("EscapeDebugTime")
				v391 = type(v392) == "number"
			end
			p386.say(v390[3] == "ME" and string.upper(v_u_4.Name) or v390[3], v390[4], v391 and 3600 or v390[1] + v390[2] - p385)
		else
			p386.say("", "", 0.01)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_23.frame(p393, _, p394) -- name: frame
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_24
	if not v_u_25 then
		return nil
	end
	local v395 = v_u_14[1]
	for _, v396 in ipairs(v_u_14) do
		if v396[1] > p393 then
			break
		end
		v395 = v396
	end
	v_u_23.showSet(p393)
	v_u_23.light(p393, p394)
	v_u_23.lines(p393, p394)
	local v397 = v_u_23.boatCF((math.min(p393, 24)))
	if p393 < 28.2 then
		if p393 < 24 then
			v_u_22.Cove4.placeBoat(v_u_25.boat, v397)
		else
			v_u_23.wreckFrame(p393)
		end
		v_u_23.levFrame(p393, v397)
		v_u_23.crewFrame(p393, v397)
		v_u_23.policeFrame(p393)
		v_u_23.seaFrame(p393, v397)
		v_u_23.noteFrame(p393)
	elseif p393 < 39 then
		v_u_23.deepFrame(p393)
	elseif p393 < 44.2 then
		v_u_23.templeFrame(p393)
	else
		v_u_23.hallFrame(p393)
	end
	p394.headForce = p393 >= 51.8 and p393 < 54.6 and true or nil
	return v_u_24[v395[2]](p393, v397)
end

		local function v_u_177(p160, p161) -- name: track
			local v162 = #p161
			if p160 <= p161[1][1] then
				return p161[1][2], p161[1][3], 0
			end
			if p161[v162][1] <= p160 then
				return p161[v162][2], p161[v162][3], 0
			end
			for v163 = 2, v162 do
				local v164 = p161[v163]
				if p160 > v164[1] then
					continue
				end
				local v165 = p161[v163 - 1]
				local v166 = (p160 - v165[1]) / (v164[1] - v165[1])
				local v167 = (v164[2] - v165[2]) ^ 2 + (v164[3] - v165[3]) ^ 2
				local v168 = math.sqrt(v167) / (v164[1] - v165[1])
				local v169 = v165[2]
				local v170 = v169 + (v164[2] - v169) * v166
				local v171 = v165[3]
				local v172 = v171 + (v164[3] - v171) * v166
				local v173 = v164[2] - v165[2]
				local v174 = v164[3] - v165[3]
				local v175 = -v173
				local v176 = -v174
				return v170, v172, v168, math.atan2(v175, v176)
			end
		end

	local function v_u_247(p233) -- name: refreshPlay
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_232, (copy) v_u_7
		local v234 = v_u_11:GetAttribute("PlayAgain")
		local v235
		if v234 == "going" then
			v235 = "going"
		elseif v234 == "in" then
			v235 = "in"
		else
			local v236 = v_u_3.W:GetAttribute("PlayAgainClosesAt")
			local v237
			if type(v236) == "number" then
				v237 = v236 <= workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
			else
				v237 = false
			end
			v235 = v237 and "closed" or "idle"
		end
		local v238 = "PLAY AGAIN"
		local v239 = nil
		if v235 == "going" then
			v238 = "STARTING..."
		elseif v235 ~= "closed" then
			local v240 = v_u_3.W:GetAttribute("PlayAgainEndsAt")
			local v241 = v_u_3.W:GetAttribute("PlayAgainCount")
			local v242 = v_u_3.W:GetAttribute("PlayAgainTotal")
			if type(v241) == "number" and v241 > 0 then
				local v243 = tonumber(v242) or v241
				v238 = "PLAY AGAIN " .. v241 .. "/" .. math.max(v241, v243)
				if type(v240) == "number" then
					local v244 = v240 - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
					local v245 = math.ceil(v244)
					v239 = math.max(0, v245)
				end
			end
		end
		if p233.flashUntil and os.clock() < p233.flashUntil then
			v238 = p233.flashText
			v239 = nil
		end
		if p233.state ~= v235 then
			p233.state = v235
			v_u_17.setColors(p233.btn, v_u_232[v235])
			if v235 == "closed" and (p233.partner and (p233.partner.Parent and v_u_7.SelectedObject == p233.btn)) then
				v_u_7.SelectedObject = p233.partner
			end
		end
		if p233.text ~= v238 then
			p233.text = v238
			p233.btn.Label.Text = v238
		end
		local v246 = v239 ~= nil
		if p233.chip.Visible ~= v246 then
			p233.chip.Visible = v246
			if v246 then
				v_u_17.pop(p233.chip, 0.3)
			end
		end
		if v246 and p233.chipText.Text ~= tostring(v239) then
			p233.chipText.Text = tostring(v239)
		end
	end

	elseif p277.id == "Size" then
		return v_u_15.get(v_u_12.holeLevel(v_u_9, p278)).name
	elseif p277.id == "Speed" then
		return string.format("%.1f/s", 1 / p278)

	end

local function v_u_607(p598) -- name: watchStart

	end

local function v_u_612(p608) -- name: money
	local v609 = math.floor(p608)
	local v610 = tostring(v609):reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()

		v610 = v610:sub(2) or v610
	end
	return v611 .. v610
end

local function v_u_446() -- name: refresh

v_u_396 = function(p447)
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_377, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_15
	local v448 = v_u_377.rows[p447]
	if v_u_377.open and (v448 and v448.state == "buy") and not (v_u_8:GetAttribute("Escaped") or (v_u_8:GetAttribute("SentToLobby") or workspace:GetAttribute("MatchAborted"))) then
		if os.clock() - v_u_377.lastBuy >= 0.25 then
			v_u_377.lastBuy = os.clock()
			local v449 = v_u_20:FindFirstChild("Robot")
			if v449 then
				v449:FireServer("Buy", p447)
			end

		end
	else
		if v448 and v448.state == "poor" then
			v_u_19.play("Switch", {

			})
		end
		return
	end
end

local function v_u_167(p163, p164, p165) -- name: punchPose

			return p449, true
		else
			return p449 .. "Lite", false
		end
	elseif p449 == "Mine" then

	end
end

function v_u_59.flip(p529, p530) -- name: flip

			["dx"] = p529.dx or p529.x - v_u_48.st.x,
			["ds"] = p529.ds or p529.s - v_u_48.st.s
		}
		for _, v531 in ipairs({
			"ArmA1",
			"ArmA2",
			"ArmB1",
			"ArmB2"
		}) do
			local v532 = p529.item.rig.bones[v531]
			if not v532 then
				continue

		end

		})

	end
end

function v_u_59.ghostFrame(p539, p540, p541) -- name: ghostFrame

function v_u_59.viewsFrame(p624, p625) -- name: viewsFrame
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_48, (copy) v_u_59

function v_u_59.onSnap(p628) -- name: onSnap
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_48, (copy) v_u_40, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_59
	if v_u_48 then
		local v629 = v_u_48.st
		local v630 = v_u_48
		v630.snapN = v630.snapN + 1
		v_u_48.snap = p628
		v_u_40.snap = p628
		if v_u_48.synced then
			v_u_13.apply(v629, p628)
		else
			v_u_48.synced = true
			local v631 = p628.t
			local v632 = p628.s
			local v633 = p628.x
			local v634 = p628.vs
			local v635 = p628.vx
			v629.t = v631
			v629.s = v632
			v629.x = v633
			v629.vs = v634
			v629.vx = v635
		end
		for _, v636 in ipairs(p628.ents) do
			local v637 = v_u_48.views[v636.id]
			if not (v637 or v_u_48.deadIds[v636.id]) then
				v637 = v_u_59.addView(v636)
			end
			if not v637 or (v637.ghost or v637.dead) then
				continue
			end
			local v638 = v636.s
			local v639 = v636.x
			local v640 = p628.t
			v637.netS = v638
			v637.netX = v639
			v637.netT = v640
			local v641 = v636.vs
			local v642 = v636.vx
			local v643 = v636.state
			local v644 = v636.hp
			local v645 = v_u_48.snapN
			v637.vs = v641
			v637.vx = v642
			v637.state = v643
			v637.hp = v644
			v637.seen = v645
			if v636.side == 0 then
				continue
			end
			v637.side = v636.side
		end
		for _, v646 in pairs(v_u_48.views) do
			if v646.ghost or (v646.dead or v_u_48.snapN - v646.seen < 3) then
				continue
			end
			v_u_59.dropView(v646)
		end
		for v647, v648 in ipairs(p628.crew) do
			local v649 = v_u_48.bySlot[v648.slot or v647]
			if not v649 or v649.id == v_u_48.me then
				continue
			end
			local v650 = v648.charge
			local v651 = v648.chargeFrac
			v649.charge = v650
			v649.chargeFrac = v651
		end
		v_u_48.ampGoal = v_u_48.boss and 2.4 or (p628.zone == 3 and 2.3 or (p628.zone == 2 and 1.4 or (p628.zone == 4 and 1.6 or 1)))
		v_u_48.locked = p628.active >= 2
		v_u_48.helmLeft = p628.helmLeft
		local v652 = v_u_48.order[p628.helm]
		if v652 and (not v_u_48.swap and v652 ~= v_u_48.helmId) then
			v_u_59.setHelm(v652)
		end
	end
end

			continue

		local v668 = v667.s

function v_u_59.crash(p671, p672) -- name: crash
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_38, (ref) v_u_48
	local v673 = v_u_38[p671.what]
	if v673 then
		local v674 = p671.side or 0
		local v675 = v_u_48.calm and 0.4 or 1
		local v676 = v_u_48
		v676.pitchV = v676.pitchV + v673.pitch * v675
		local v677 = v_u_48
		v677.heaveV = v677.heaveV + v673.heave * v675
		local v678 = v_u_48
		v678.backV = v678.backV + v673.back * v675
		local v679 = v_u_48
		v679.yawV = v679.yawV - v674 * v673.yaw * v675
		local v680 = v_u_48
		v680.rollV = v680.rollV - v674 * v673.roll * v675
		local v681 = v_u_48
		local v682 = v_u_48.camHit
		local v683 = v673.cam * v675
		v681.camHit = math.max(v682, v683)
		v_u_48.camSide = v674
		if v673.toss then
			for _, v684 in pairs(v_u_48.crew) do

			end
		end
	end
end
function v_u_50.SeaHit(p685) -- name: SeaHit

	local v687
	if v_u_48 and v_u_48.localMode then
		v687 = v_u_48.clock

		v687 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

		v688.hitSide = v689
		v688.hitBig = v686

end

function v_u_50.SeaWave(p703) -- name: SeaWave
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_48, (copy) v_u_39, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_31, (copy) v_u_59
	local v704 = v_u_48.crew[p703.by]
	if v704 then
		local v705
		if v_u_48 and v_u_48.localMode then
			v705 = v_u_48.clock
		else
			v705 = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		end
		v704.slamT = v705
		v704.charge = 0
		v704.chargeFrac = 0
		v704.punchSide = p703.side
	end
	if p703.by == v_u_48.me then

	end
	local v706 = v_u_48
	v706.rollV = v706.rollV + p703.side * 2.2 * (v_u_48.calm and 0.4 or 1)
	v_u_48.shake(1.2)

	end
	for _, v708 in ipairs(p703.goneEnts or v_u_39) do

function v_u_59.frame(_, p826) -- name: frame

function v_u_59.botThink(p848, p849) -- name: botThink
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_48
	local v850 = v_u_48.srv
	local v851 = v850.crew[p848]
	local v852 = v850.t
	p849.next = p849.next or 0
	local v853 = v850.track.rows
	local v854 = v850.x
	local v855 = v854
	for _, v856 in ipairs(v853) do
		if v856.s <= v850.s - 5 then
			continue
		end
		if v856.s < v850.s + 150 then
			v854 = v856.lane
		end
	end
	local v857 = (v854 - v855) / 12
	p849.steer = math.clamp(v857, -1, 1)
	for _, v858 in ipairs(v850.ents) do
		if not v858.parry or (v858.state ~= "warn" or (v858.who ~= p848 or (v858.t1 - 0.16 > v852 or v852 > v858.t1))) then
			continue
		end
		local v859 = p849.punches
		local v860 = v858.side
		table.insert(v859, v860)
		p849.next = v852 + 0.2
		return
	end
	for _, v861 in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		if not v850.hooks[v861] or p849.next > v852 then
			continue
		end
		local v862 = p849.punches
		table.insert(v862, v861)
		p849.next = v852 + 0.34
		return
	end
	if p849.next <= v852 and v851 then
		local v863 = v851.lastSide == 1 and -1 or 1
		local v864 = p849.punches
		table.insert(v864, v863)
		p849.next = v852 + 0.36
	end
end
function v_u_59.localTick() -- name: localTick

		table.clear(v869.punches)

end
function v_u_59.localStep(p874) -- name: localStep

function v_u_645.SeaHit(p773) -- name: SeaHit
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_27, (ref) v_u_39, (copy) v_u_433, (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_19

	if p773.what == "Rock" or (p773.what == "CutterRam" or (p773.what == "Chain" or p773.what == "Mine")) then
		local v779 = v_u_36.Crash
		if v779 then

			local v794 = p788.part
			local v795 = v_u_20
			local v796 = v_u_27.waterAt and (v_u_27.waterAt(v793, 15) or 0) or 0
			local v797 = v_u_27.waterAt and (v_u_27.waterAt(v793, -15) or 0) or 0

		v_u_39.mark = v_u_39.mark % #v_u_39.marks + 1
		local v801 = v_u_39.marks[v_u_39.mark]
		v801.fn = v799
		v801.t1 = v800

			if v803 then

	function v_u_594.sadPose(p666, p667) -- name: sadPose
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_41, (copy) v_u_594
		local v668 = v_u_41.bubble.sad

				v_u_594.sadPop(true)

					local v674 = v670 / v669.INFLATE

					local v679 = v677 * 3.141592653589793 * 3

				table.insert(p666, v682)
				local v683 = CFrame.new

			end
		else

		end

	function v_u_594.rainDrop(p716, p717, p718) -- name: rainDrop

		p717.vy = (1.8 + math.random() * 1.2) * (v724 - v723) / v_u_10.DRAIN.y1
		p717.ph = math.random() * 3.141592653589793 * 2
		p717.popY = v723 + 0.6 + math.random() * 2.2
		p717.size = 0.35 + math.random() * 0.3

		end
	end
	function v_u_594.rainPose(p730, p731, p732) -- name: rainPose
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_41, (copy) v_u_594, (copy) v_u_35
		local v733 = v_u_41.bubble.rain
		if v733 then
			local v734 = v_u_594.RAIN
			local v735 = os.clock()
			local v736 = v735 - v733.t0 < v734.SECS
			if not (v736 or v733.stopped) then
				v733.stopped = true
				for _, v737 in ipairs(v733.conf) do
					v737.Rate = 0
				end
			end
			local v738 = type(p730) ~= "number" and (-1 / 0) or p730 + 0.3
			local v739 = 0
			for _, v740 in ipairs(v733.drops) do
				local v741 = v740.ball and (v735 - v740.born or -1) or -1
				if v740.ball then
					v739 = v739 + 1
				end
				if v741 < 0 then
					continue
				end
				local v742 = v740.x
				local v743 = v741 * 2.3 + v740.ph
				local v744 = v742 + math.sin(v743) * 0.3
				local v745 = v740.y0 - v740.vy * v741
				local v746 = v740.z
				local v747 = v741 * 1.7 + v740.ph
				local v748 = v746 + math.cos(v747) * 0.22
				local v749 = v740.popY
				if v745 <= math.max(v749, v738) then
					v733.att.WorldPosition = Vector3.new(v744, v745, v748)
					v733.pop:Emit(v733.shine and 3 or 2)
					if v736 then
						v_u_594.rainDrop(v733, v740, v735 + math.random() * 0.3)
						local v750 = v740.ball
						table.insert(p731, v750)
						local v751 = v_u_35
						table.insert(p732, v751)
						if not v740.shine then
							continue
						end
						local v752 = v740.shine
						table.insert(p731, v752)
						local v753 = v_u_35
						table.insert(p732, v753)
					else
						v740.ball:Destroy()
						if v740.shine then
							v740.shine:Destroy()
						end
						v740.ball = nil
						v740.shine = nil
					end
				else
					local v754 = CFrame.new(v744, v745, v748)
					local v755 = v740.ball
					table.insert(p731, v755)
					table.insert(p732, v754)
					if not v740.shine then
						continue
					end
					local v756 = v740.shine
					table.insert(p731, v756)
					local v757 = v754 * CFrame.Angles(0, v741 * 3 + v740.ph, 0) * CFrame.new(v740.size * 0.26, v740.size * 0.2, 0)
					table.insert(p732, v757)
				end
			end
			if v739 == 0 and v735 - v733.t0 > v734.SECS + v734.LIFE then
				v_u_594.rainStop()
			end
		end
	end

	function v_u_594.pose(p760, p761, p762, p763) -- name: pose
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_594, (copy) v_u_41, (copy) v_u_37, (copy) v_u_65, (copy) v_u_595, (copy) v_u_35, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_10

		local v765 = v764.parts

		if v767.state == "start" then
			v769 = p760 - v767.startAt < v_u_37.BUBBLE.START
		else
			v769 = false

			end

				v774.Color = v782

			table.insert(p763, v783)

			for v785 = 1, 4 do

				table.insert(p762, v786)

			local v791 = v766.PistonL * CFrame.new(v788, 0, 0)
			table.insert(p763, v791)
			local v792 = v765.PistonR
			table.insert(p762, v792)
			local v793 = v766.PistonR * CFrame.new(-v788, 0, 0)
			table.insert(p763, v793)
			local v794 = not v769 and 0 or (p760 - v767.startAt) * 6
			if v794 ~= 0 or v764.duckTurn ~= 0 then
				v764.duckTurn = v794

					table.insert(p762, v798)

				table.insert(p763, v800)
			end
		end
		for v802 = 1, 4 do
			local v803 = v765["Bulb" .. v802]

			if v768 then

		if v768 or os.clock() <= v767.sadAt then

				v_u_594.sadPop(false)
			end
		else
			v767.sadAt = os.clock() + 6 + math.random() * 2
			v_u_594.sadBlow()
		end
		v_u_594.sadPose(p762, p763)
		v_u_594.rainPose(p761, p762, p763)
		for _, v807 in pairs(v_u_41.blows) do
			local v808 = v807.d
			local v809, v810, v811, v812, v813 = v_u_12.bubbleAt(v808, p760)

			local v816
			if v809 == "inflate" then

				v816 = v814 * math.max(0.15, v813)

				v816 = v814 * (0.75 - v819)
				v814 = v820
			elseif v809 == "pop" then
				v814 = 0.05
				v816 = 0.05
			else
				v816 = v814
			end
			local v821 = math.max(v814, v816)
			local v822 = v807.ball.Size.X - v821
			if math.abs(v822) > 0.02 then
				v807.ball.Size = Vector3.new(v821, v821, v821)
			end
			local v823 = v807.ball
			table.insert(p762, v823)
			table.insert(p763, v815)
			local v824 = v807.shine
			table.insert(p762, v824)
			local v825 = v815 * CFrame.Angles(0, p760 * 2, 0) * CFrame.new(v821 * 0.28, v821 * 0.22, 0)
			table.insert(p763, v825)
			if not v807.duck then
				continue
			end
			local v826 = v815 * CFrame.Angles(0, p760 * 0.8, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -0.08, 0)

	function v_u_850.place(p924, p925, p926, p927, p928, p929) -- name: place
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_850, (copy) v_u_10
		local v930 = p924 - Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0)
		local v931 = (p928 - p924):Dot(p926) - 0.4
		local v932 = -1
		for _, v933 in ipairs({ p929, -p929 }) do
			local v934 = p927 * v933
			local v935 = v_u_850.free(p924, v934, 2.4)
			local v936 = v_u_850.free
			local v937 = math.min(v935, v936(v930, v934, 2.4))
			local v938 = p924 + v934 * v_u_850.SIDE
			local v939 = v938.X

			if ((not v942 or type(v943) ~= "number") and 0 or math.max(0, v943)) < p925 - 0.3 then
				v937 = math.min(v937, 0.9)
			end
			local v944 = v_u_850.SIDE
			while v_u_850.MIN < v944 and v937 < v_u_850.reach(v944, v931 - (v_u_850.SIDE - v944)) + 0.1 do
				local v945 = v_u_850.MIN
				local v946 = v944 - 0.1
				v944 = math.max(v945, v946)
			end
			if v_u_850.SIDE <= v944 then
				return v933, v944, 0
			end
			if v932 >= v944 then
				break
			end
			p929 = v933
			v932 = v944
		end
		local v947 = v_u_850.free(p924, p926, 4)
		local v948 = v_u_850.free
		local v949 = math.min(v947, v948(v930, p926, 4)) - 2
		local v950 = v_u_850.SIDE - v932
		return p929, v932, math.clamp(v949, 0, v950)
	end

	function v_u_850.eye(p951, p952, p953, p954, p955, p956) -- name: eye
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_850
		local v957 = nil
		local v958 = nil
		local v959 = nil
		for _, v960 in ipairs(v_u_850.EYES) do
			local v961
			if v960[4] == 0 then
				v961 = p955
			else
				v961 = v960[4]
			end
			local v962 = p951.X
			local v963 = p952 + 2.1 + v960[3]
			local v964 = p951.Z
			local v965 = Vector3.new(v962, v963, v964) + p954 * (v960[1] * v961) + p953 * v960[2] - p951
			local v966 = v965.Magnitude
			local v967 = v965.Unit
			local v968 = v_u_850.free(p951, v967, v966 + 0.45) - 0.45
			local v969 = math.clamp(v968, 0, v966)
			local v970 = {}
			local v971 = p951 + v967 * v969
			local v972
			if v960[4] == 0 then
				v972 = nil
			else
				v972 = v960[4]
			end
			__set_list(v970, 1, {v971, v972})
			if v966 - 0.01 <= v969 then
				if v_u_850.sees(v970[1], p956) then
					return v970[1], v970[2]
				end
				v957 = v957 or v970
			else
				if v958 and v959 >= v969 then
					continue
				end
				v959 = v969
				v958 = v970
			end
		end
		local v973 = v957 or v958
		return v973[1], v973[2]
	end
	function v_u_850.shot(p974) -- name: shot

			local function v_u_515(p511, p512) -- name: foamAt
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_14
				if p511.kind == "deck" then
					if p512 >= 0 then
						return p511.x, p511.z
					end
				elseif p511.kind == "gutter" then
					if p512 < v_u_14.GUTTER.edgeY then
						return p511.x, p511.z
					end
				elseif p511.kind == "step" and p512 >= 0.12 then
					local v513 = v_u_14.STEPS
					for v514 = 1, v513.n do
						if v_u_14.LANDING.y1 - v513.rise * v514 >= p512 then
							continue
						end
						return v513.x0 + v513.run * (v514 - 1) + 0.15, p511.z
					end
				end
				return nil
			end
			local function v_u_534(p516, p517, p518, p519) -- name: duckState
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_38, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_27
				local v520 = v_u_38.batch
				if p516.st == "off" or not v520 then
					return nil
				end
				local v521, v522, v523 = v_u_14.duckPos(v520.kind, p517, v520.t0, p518, v_u_27)
				local v524 = 0
				if (p516.st == "grow" or p516.st == "swim") and not v523 then
					local v525 = p516.scale
					p516.st = "leave"
					p516.t = p519
					p516.s0 = v525
				end
				if p516.st == "grow" then
					if not p516.g0 then
						local v526 = p516.born
						local v527 = p518 + 0.2
						local v528 = math.max(v526, v527)
						p516.g0 = p518
						p516.g1 = v528
					end
					local v529 = (p518 - p516.g0) / (p516.g1 - p516.g0)
					local v530 = math.clamp(v529, 0, 1)
					p516.scale = v530 * 0.7 + 0.3
					if v530 >= 1 then
						p516.st = "swim"
					end
				elseif p516.st == "swim" then
					p516.scale = 1
				elseif p516.st == "leave" or p516.st == "caught" then
					local v531 = (p519 - p516.t) / 0.3
					local v532 = math.clamp(v531, 0, 1)
					p516.scale = p516.s0 + (0.3 - p516.s0) * v532
					if p516.st == "leave" then
						v524 = v532 * -0.4
					else
						local v533 = v532 * 3.141592653589793 / 2
						v524 = math.sin(v533) * 0.9
					end
					if v532 >= 1 then
						p516.st = "end"
					end
				elseif p516.st == "end" then
					p516.st = "off"
					return nil
				end
				return v521, v522, v524
			end

	local function v_u_527(p518) -- name: makeActor
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_435
		local v519 = p518:Clone()
		for _, v520 in ipairs(v519:GetDescendants()) do
			if not (v520:IsA("WeldConstraint") and (v520.Part0 and v520.Part1)) then
				continue
			end
			local v521 = Instance.new("Weld")
			local v522 = v520.Part0
			local v523 = v520.Part1
			v521.Part0 = v522
			v521.Part1 = v523
			v521.C0 = v520.Part0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(v520.Part1.CFrame)
			v521.Parent = v520.Parent
			v520:Destroy()
		end
		local v524 = {
			["model"] = v519,
			["root"] = v519:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
			["joints"] = {}
		}
		for _, v525 in ipairs(v519:GetDescendants()) do
			if v525:IsA("BaseScript") or v525:IsA("Animator") then
				v525:Destroy()
			elseif v525:IsA("BasePart") then
				v525.CanCollide = false
				v525.CanQuery = false
				v525.CanTouch = false
			else
				if not ((v525:IsA("AnimationConstraint") or v525:IsA("Motor6D")) and v_u_435[v525.Name]) then
					continue
				end
				v524.joints[v525.Name] = v525
			end
		end
		local v_u_526 = v519:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if v_u_526 then
			pcall(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_526
				v_u_526.EvaluateStateMachine = false
			end)
			v_u_526.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
		end
		v524.height = (v_u_526 and v_u_526.HipHeight or 2) + v524.root.Size.Y / 2
		v524.root.Anchored = true
		v519.Parent = workspace
		return v524
	end

	function v_u_431.groundExact(p438, p439, p440) -- name: groundExact

			else

	function v_u_431.shaftFeet(p589, p590, p591, p592) -- name: shaftFeet
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_431
		local v593 = math.cos(p591)
		local v594 = math.sin(p591)
		local v595 = (1 / 0)
		local v596 = (-1 / 0)

				continue
			end

		end

			v596 = v597
		end
		return v596, v597 - v595
	end

	function v_u_431.shaftFrame(p661, p662) -- name: shaftFrame
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_431
		local v663 = v_u_431.shaft
		local v664 = v_u_431.pick
		local v665 = v_u_431.y + 0.5
		local v666
		if v664 then

			v666, v667 = v_u_431.shaftFeet(v664.x, v664.z, v664.yaw, v665)
			if p662 - v_u_431.pickAt >= 1 then

		else
			v666 = nil
		end
		if not v664 then
			v664 = v_u_431.shaftPick(v665)
			local v669 = v_u_431
			v_u_431.pick = v664

			v666 = v664.y
		end
		local v670 = v_u_431.pos.X
		local v671 = v_u_431.pos.Z
		local v672 = -10 * p661
		local v673 = 1 - math.exp(v672)
		local v674 = v670 + (v664.x - v670) * v673
		local v675 = v671 + (v664.z - v671) * v673
		v_u_431.pos = Vector3.new(v674, 0, v675)
		local v676 = v_u_431
		local v677 = v_u_431.yaw
		local v678 = v664.yaw
		local v679 = -7 * p661
		local v680 = 1 - math.exp(v679)
		v676.yaw = v677 + ((v678 - v677 + 3.141592653589793) % 6.283185307179586 - 3.141592653589793) * v680
		v_u_431.hop = nil
		local v681 = v_u_431
		local v682 = v681.y
		local v683 = v666 - v_u_431.y
		local v684 = -(v_u_431.y < v666 and 30 or 18) * p661
		v681.y = v682 + v683 * (1 - math.exp(v684))
		local v685 = v_u_431.shaftBox
		local v686 = v663.x0
		local v687 = v663.z0
		local v688 = v663.x1
		local v689 = v663.z1

		v685.x1 = v688
		v685.z1 = v689

		local v690 = v_u_431.nearHead
		local v691 = v_u_431.y + 0.6
		return v690(Vector3.new(v674, v691, v675), 6)

	function v_u_431.climbFrame(p722, p723) -- name: climbFrame
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_431, (copy) v_u_35
		local v724 = v_u_431.exit
		local v725 = v_u_35.CLIMB
		local v726 = v724.a
		local v727 = v726.X
		local v728 = v726.Z
		local v729 = Vector3.new(v727, 0, v728)
		local v730 = v724.b
		local v731 = v730.X
		local v732 = v730.Z
		local v733 = Vector3.new(v731, 0, v732)
		if not v724.ready then
			v724.ready = true
			v_u_431.refreshCrate()
			v724.floorY = v_u_431.groundExact(v729.X, v729.Z, v724.a.Y + 0.5)
			local v734 = v724.floorY
			local v735 = v_u_431.groundExact(v733.X, v733.Z, v724.b.Y + 0.5)
			v724.rimY = math.max(v734, v735)
			local v736 = v724.floorY
			local v737 = v724.rimY - v725.REACH
			v724.climbY = math.max(v736, v737)
			local v738 = v725.REAR
			local v739 = v725.MANTLE
			v724.tR = v738
			v724.tM = v739

			v724.tC = math.max(0, v740)
			local v741 = v724.dir
			local v742 = -v741.X
			local v743 = -v741.Z
			v724.yaw = math.atan2(v742, v743)
			local v744 = v_u_431.pos
			local v745 = v744.X
			local v746 = v744.Z
			local v747 = Vector3.new(v745, 0, v746)
			if (v747 - v729).Magnitude > 2 then
				if v724.rect then
					local v748 = v724.rect.cx
					local v749 = v724.rect.cz
					v747 = Vector3.new(v748, 0, v749) or v729
				else
					v747 = v729
				end
				v_u_431.y = v724.floorY
			end
			local v750 = v_u_431.y
			local v751 = v_u_431.yaw
			v724.fromXZ = v747
			v724.fromY = v750
			v724.fromYaw = v751
			v724.it = {
				["phase"] = "rear",
				["k"] = 0,
				["wallD"] = nil,
				["rimY"] = nil,
				["vy"] = 0,
				["wallD"] = v725.WALL_D,
				["rimY"] = v724.rimY
			}
			v724.lastY = v_u_431.y
		end
		local v752 = p723 - v724.t0
		if v724.tR + v724.tC + v724.tM <= v752 then
			return true
		end
		local v753 = v724.it
		local v754, v755, v756
		if v752 < v724.tR then
			v754 = math.max(v752, 0) / v724.tR
			local v757 = math.clamp(v754, 0, 1)
			local v758 = v757 * v757 * (3 - 2 * v757)
			v753.phase = "rear"
			v729 = v724.fromXZ:Lerp(v729, v758)
			v755 = v724.fromY + (v724.floorY - v724.fromY) * v758
			local v759 = v724.fromYaw
			v756 = v759 + ((v724.yaw - v759 + 3.141592653589793) % 6.283185307179586 - 3.141592653589793) * v758
		elseif v752 < v724.tR + v724.tC then
			v754 = (v752 - v724.tR) / v724.tC
			v753.phase = "climb"
			v755 = v724.floorY + (v724.climbY - v724.floorY) * v754
			v756 = v724.yaw
		else
			v754 = (v752 - v724.tR - v724.tC) / v724.tM
			v753.phase = "mantle"
			if v754 < 0.55 then
				local v760 = v724.climbY
				local v761 = v724.rimY - 0.1 - v724.climbY
				local v762 = v754 / 0.55
				local v763 = math.clamp(v762, 0, 1)
				v755 = v760 + v761 * (v763 * v763 * (3 - 2 * v763))
			else
				local v764 = v724.rimY - 0.1
				local v765 = (v754 - 0.55) / 0.25
				local v766 = math.clamp(v765, 0, 1)
				v755 = v764 + 0.1 * (v766 * v766 * (3 - 2 * v766))
			end
			local v767 = (v754 - 0.3) / 0.7
			local v768 = math.clamp(v767, 0, 1)
			v729 = v729:Lerp(v733, v768 * v768 * (3 - 2 * v768))
			v756 = v724.yaw
		end
		v753.k = math.clamp(v754, 0, 1)
		v753.vy = p722 > 0.0001 and ((v755 - v724.lastY) / p722 or 0) or 0
		v724.lastY = v755
		local v769 = v_u_431
		local v770 = v_u_431
		local v771 = v_u_431
		v_u_431.pos = v729
		v769.y = v755
		v770.yaw = v756
		v771.hop = nil
		local v772 = -math.sin(v756)
		local v773 = -math.cos(v756)
		local v774 = Vector3.new(v772, 0, v773)
		v753.wallD = (v724.wallPt - v729):Dot(v774)
		v753.rimY = v724.rimY
		local v775 = v_u_431
		local v776
		if v753.phase == "mantle" and v754 >= 0.5 then
			v776 = nil
		else
			v776 = v724.box or nil
		end
		v775.box = v776
		return false
	end

	function v_u_431.gapAhead(p1026, p1027, p1028, p1029) -- name: gapAhead
